description: We’re a two-person team combining engineering and design. One of us builds the simulation model and code, turning real NASA data, from solar storms to oxygen needs, into game mechanics that teach how a lunar outpost actually survives. The other is our designer, shaping the look and feel so kids aged 7–12 can understand and enjoy every decision they make. Our goal: a game where every choice involves a real engineering trade-off, and every number comes from real science.
